content.comment_body: Hello, Could someone assist me in finding a [product_name] solution for mitigating Direct On Line Motor Inrush Current? I'm using analog inputs to measure motor current and power. One method employs a 50A to 0-5V DC transducer, and the other retrieves power values through modbus from a power meter. Both signals are routed through analog amplifiers before reaching comparators. I need to delay the impact of the motor inrush for approximately 3 seconds to prevent the comparators from triggering too early during motor start-up. Best regards, [user_name]
Hello everyone, I just found the Analog Ramp Block feature. My question was unnecessary. Sorry for taking your time. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user was looking for a way within [product_name] to manage transient inrush currents on analog inputs during a DOL motor start, aiming to prevent premature comparator triggering. Initially unaware of built-in options, the user later identified the Analog Ramp Block as a suitable solution and acknowledged their oversight. The discussion highlights a gap in understanding available analog input filtering features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that [product_name] would offer a straightforward solution to delay or ramp analog inputs, helping filter out inrush currents and avoid unintended comparator activation.
